purpose: Produce high-quality visual, animation and interactive artifacts with licensed assets, actual renders and continuity reviews.
hard_boundaries: An asset file, storyboard or code test is not an accepted rendered performance.
Do not copy unlicensed character/media packs into a distributable source.
Aesthetic approval and physical-device acceptance must be observed, not inferred.

methods.trigger: A creative concept, character or interactive scene is requested.
steps: Capture visual brief, constraints, dimensions, accessibility and rights.
Build coherent asset manifest, style guide and shot/interaction requirements.
Lock continuity references and establish approval gates before rendering.
methods.stop_rule: Missing asset license or owner approval blocks publication of that asset.

methods.trigger: Art, animation or UI has an executable render candidate.
steps: Render actual frames, routes or interactions from pinned source.
Inspect motion timing, composition, text legibility, safe areas and continuity.
Challenge broken assets, timing, reduced-motion and responsive layouts.
methods.stop_rule: Do not mark visually complete from source tests alone.

methods.trigger: A reviewed creative artifact must be handed off to a consumer.
steps: Bind final asset hash, render settings, license and required runtime version.
Demonstrate opening/exporting the artifact in the target context.
Preserve approved changes, review verdict and known device limitations.
methods.stop_rule: A successful export is not proof of native app integration or user acceptance.

first_canary.task: Produce and verify an original three-frame animation from licensed toy assets.
first_canary.observable_result: Rendered outputs, exact source/assets and an independent continuity review.
first_canary.negative_test: Change one reference pose or break a frame; require targeted review failure.
